messages:
Anya Venkataraman: I pushed a prototype for per-service suppression granularity + a condensed policy pill. The idea: teams can choose "all routes", "service only", or "route only" when creating a maintenance window. Uploading artboard link.
Theo Brooks: Nice. Does the policy pill show inheritance? Like org > team > route? We should avoid surprises.
Anya Venkataraman: Yes  pill shows source: Org / Team / Local with a tiny chevron to expand source details. If inherited, we show an "Inherited" badge and a view link.
Riley Morgan: UX nit: wording "service only" might be vague. Suggest "Selected services" and a typeahead to add multiple services. Microcopy: 'Applies only to the selected services and their routes.'
Sam Lee: Accessibility: the typeahead must expose selected items as removable tokens with clear labels and keyboard focus. Also ensure screen readers announce token count.
a11y-bot: Add: when the inheritance collapses into a pill, provide aria-describedby for source detail and ensure the expand chevron announces "expand policy source".
Theo Brooks: Preview idea: small condensed timeline in the pill popover that shows next 24 hours with shaded blocks where suppression applies. Hover/focus shows absolute times.
Anya Venkataraman: I mocked that. It's a tiny 24h row with blocks and a tooltip on hover showing "Mon 02:00-03:00 (team TZ)". Also shows a warning icon if DST or timezone ambiguity exists.
Riley Morgan: Copy tweak: change "Suppress" language to "Pause notifications" in UI; keep 'suppressed' in logs. Less harsh.
Sam Lee: Audit flow: any change to an inherited org policy must create a request workflow with prefilled diff and optional justification. Route owners can 'request exception' which generates a ticket. Show status in the pill: Pending / Approved / Rejected.
Anya Venkataraman: Will mock request flow. Also adding a tiny "Impact summary" under the pill: counts for affected routes and users, and estimated SMS count avoided.
Theo Brooks: For the impact numbers, add a hover to show assumptions: sample window, average alerts per route, sms rate. Make them transparent.
a11y-bot: Ensure impact summary is accessible: each stat should be readable and the assumptions link should open a modal with focus trap.
Riley Morgan: One more copy ask: change action button from "Save" to "Save schedule" and a secondary "Save & notify owners". Keeps intent clear.
Sam Lee: Final UX: when bulk-applying a schedule, show a compact conflict detector that lists routes that would be overwritten and which are org-locked. Provide simple resolve actions inline.
Anya Venkataraman: Thanks all 44d I'll iterate mock and add keyboard flows + a11y checklist. Drive: https://drive.redwood/design/per-service-suppression-pill-iter1
design-bot: Reminder  add final screens to figma before critique Wednesday 10am PT.
Anya Venkataraman: Closing thread; drop tiny follow-ups on the figma comments.
